programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 702
programme.desc: Bianca og Morten bor i Randers med tung trafik, der suser forbi udenfor - og to små piger, der har lært at åbne hoveddøren. Det dur ikke, og derfor har de bedt Boligkøb i blindes eksperter om hjælp.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 703
programme.desc: I Esbjerg har Line og Kristian fået opført deres drømmehus. Eller det troede de. Men efter kort tid i boligen må de sande, at åbne rum og store vinduer ikke er dem. De vil noget andet - men hvad?

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 704
programme.desc: For et par år solgte Birgitte sit hus - og fortrød bittert. Nu bor hun og datteren Emma til leje i dyrt nybyggeri, mens de leder efter et hus, der minder om det gamle. Kan eksperterne hjælpe dem?

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 705
programme.desc: Pernille og Aron skal køre den lange tur fra Odense til Kalundborg hver dag, og derfor vil de gerne flytte til Kalundborg, hvor de begge arbejder, så de kan bruge deres fritid til andet end at pendle.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 602
programme.desc: Kan man drive en restaurant, når man er bange for at få gæster? Svaret er selvfølgelig ”nej” – men ikke desto mindre er det virkeligheden for Hanne, som åbnede Fru Klitgaard for bare et par måneder siden.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 603
programme.desc: Bølgerne går højt på den sicilianske restaurant i Hillerød, når Lilo skiftevis kaster med gryder i køkkenet og spiller harmonika - og hans hustru, Anja, styrer slagets gang i restauranten.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 604
programme.desc: Brasilianske Jacira har drevet sin lille restaurant, O Tempo, i tre år. Og i de tre år har hun ikke fået løn. Det kan ikke blive ved med at gå, men spørgsmålet er, om Thomas på bare fem dage kan redde restauranten.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 605
programme.desc: Det danske genoptrænings-hospital Montebello ligger fantastisk smukt i Malagas højder. Desværre er der ikke noget smukt ved den mad, der serveres på stedet. Langt fra.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 606
programme.desc: Tunø er med sine blot 118 beboere og en sparsom færgeforbindelse til fastlandet en del af det udkantsdanmark, som kan være svært at holde liv i. Det vil Jan og Christina fra Thunø Kro gøre noget ved.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: The Follow Game
programme.desc: The Situation samler i al hemmelighed information, der skal fælde en af hans bofæller - og for en gangs skyld er det ikke Snooki. JWoww går ud af sit gode skind, idet Roger er forsvundet og ikke besvarer hendes opkald.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Love at the Jersey Shore
programme.desc: Alle bofællerne er optaget af hver deres flamme, men det betyder ikke, at der er fred i huset. Én af bofællerne ryger uklar med tøserne, mens Jennis lette påklædning irriterer Roger.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Sharp Objects
programme.desc: Gruppen forsøger at undgå et hajangreb på deres fisketur. Jenni konfronterer Paulys forfølger. Snooki begynder at fokusere på Vinny, da hendes kæreste afviser hendes tilnærmelser.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: The Truth Will Set You Free
programme.desc: Mike beslutter sig for, at han ikke kan vente længere med at fortælle Snookis kæreste 'sandheden'. Pauly, Vinny og Deena har det svært med at være singlerne i Shore-huset.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: One Meatball Stands Alone
programme.desc: Et stort slag bryder ud, efter Mike fortæller Jionni, at han var sammen med Snooki. Deena må høre den hårde sandhed om Joey. Nogle bofæller tager på camping, mens Vinny og Pauly laver den største prank i Shore-historien!

programme.title: Jersey Shore: After Hours 502
programme.desc: Mike, Snooki, Pauly og Deena mødes for at tale om at vende tilbage til Seaside Heights og Vinnys hjemve. Da bofællerne igen genoptager dramaet mellem Mike og Snooki, bliver stemningen lidt eksplosiv.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Geordie Fest
programme.desc: Familien fejrer Abbies 21-års fødselsdag med den ultimative fest, og selvfølgelig er Abbies mormor inviteret! Familien tager en følelsesladet afsked, da deres tid i huset er slut.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: All Change In The House
programme.desc: Geordies er tilbage! Men denne gang rusker Anna og Scotty-T op i det og introducerer fire nye deltagere. De gør deres bedste for at passe ind, og de gamle deltagere er altid parat til at vise dem, hvordan man fester igennem!

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Nathan Needs A House Party
programme.desc: Nathan rammer bunden og familien beslutter at holde en fest for at løfte hans humør. Sophie savner sin kæreste mens nybegynderne vænner sig til at være en del af familien.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Beau & Bethan Get It On!
programme.desc: Det går ikke godt mellem Nathan og Cloe, og pigerne går ud for at få nogle drinks uden at invitere ham. Beau er tiltrukket af Bethan, og det udvikler sig mellem dem.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Buckle Up! The Geordies Hit Belfast!
programme.desc: Anna fortæller slænget, at de skal til Belfast. De fester igennem i Nordirland og nyder, hvad byen har at byde på. Tahlia scorer endda en tjener! Men tingene går ned ad bakke, da Chloe og Sams forhold går helt i stykker.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The Family Is Rocked!
programme.desc: Geordies vender tilbage til Newcastle og får et chok, da et bekendt ansigt dukker op. Bethan og Beau sættes på en prøve, og Chloe og Sams forhold er ved at komme tilbage på sporet. Sophie må træffe en svær beslutning.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 6
programme.desc: Da DCC-chefen Kelli Finglass giver en tidligere aspirant en unik chance for at springe til på træningslejren efter tre uger, har hun meget at indhente.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 7
programme.desc: Hun er tilbage! Den krævende Kitty Carter kommer til Valley Ranch for at undervise de nervøse DCC-dansere i danseteknik. Så tager Charlotte Jones Anderson de forundrede cheerleadere på en privat rundtur i det nye Cowboys Stadium.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 8
programme.desc: Kelli og Judy må tage svære beslutninger, som er retfærdige, men beklagelige. Det er opgørets time for de resterende træningslejrkandidater, da der kun er to dansetimer tilbage før den sidste eliminering.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 1
programme.desc: For første gang er det pragtfulde Cowboys Stadium i Texas basen for udtagelserne til Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders. Over 600 aspiranter med drømme om at komme med i truppen 2010-2011 ankommer før solopgang til indledningsrunden.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 2
programme.desc: De 47 nye piger, som skal deltage i DCC's finaleudtagelser, har haft to uger til at forberede sig, men er de klar til at danse sammen med de 27 tilbagevendende DCC-veteraner?

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 3
programme.desc: DCC's træningslejr begynder i aften! Kandidaterne ankommer til Valley Ranch for første gang og får muligheden for at møde deres idoler og mentorer - DCC-veteranerne.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 4
programme.desc: Den anden uge af træningslejren bliver nogle af aspiranterne sendt hjem. Nogle få udvalgte veteraner skal filme et segment til Good Morning America, og de hjælper med at realisere en livslang drøm for en heldig dame.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 5
programme.desc: Uge fire af træningslejren begynder med, at de nye får en DCC-makeover. Fra hår og sminke til selvbruner og tandblegning bliver aspiranterne forvandlet til DCC-repræsentanter.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 6
programme.desc: Træningslejren er snart slut, og DCC-portrætterne står på banen. Træningslejr-aspiranterne og veteranerne er klar til deres nærbilleder, klædt i specialsyede DCC-dragter med perfekt hår og makeup.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 15
programme.desc: The first heatwave of summer has hit Barnsley and it’s adding to the pressure of an already stressful day in casualty for Sister Jane who’s in charge today. The department is hot, stuffy, and bursting with patients all needing emergency treatment.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 16
programme.desc: It’s another relentless shift for the team at Barnsley casualty and running the hub today is Sister Jane. Staff are struggling to meet the 15-minute assessment target time but doing all they can.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 17
programme.desc: It’s a big day at Barnsley Casualty, for the first time since the Covid pandemic hit the UK, staff can finally remove their masks. For some it’s a happy, welcome relief, but others aren’t ready to go mask-free just yet.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 18
programme.desc: It’s the hottest day of the year at Barnsley Casualty. Sister Vicky has the job of keeping patients and staff cool, but with temperatures outside approaching forty degrees, it won’t be easy.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 19
programme.desc: There’s a covid spike at Barnsley Casualty and positive cases are flooding in adding pressure to an already busy day. Sister Rachel is in charge today and because of covid she’s short on space and staff.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 20
programme.desc: Patients are flooding into Barnsley Casualty today and Sister Jane is in charge and up to her eyes. Suddenly a patient who has come in with stomachache goes into labor - she had no idea she was pregnant.

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: Luna and K9 Sniffers
programme.desc: A lab mix, has an extreme fear of dog parks, walks and noises at home. Meet a pack of dogs that spends its days keeping the port of Miami free of drugs, and explosives.

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: Willie, Make-A-Wish and Zena
programme.desc: A dog whose extreme fear of the stove has forced her owners to cook on a grill. Two dogs battle for control of the house. A Jack Russell terrier who can't handle the death of his pack leader.

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: Hudson & Orchid, and LA Animal Control
programme.desc: Two Great Danes battle for control. Cesar helps the city of Los Angeles' Animal Control department with its aggressive new pet ownership program by riding along with one of its officers.

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: Gus, Abbey, and Vinnie
programme.desc: Tonight Show sidekick Ed McMahon’s dog is aggressive. A beagle won't leave the house. An Australian shepherd is so territorial of his owner's house that no one has visited in two years.

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: Caged Shepherd, Tinkling Terrier
programme.desc: Troy, a German Shepherd, is aggressive towards the other animals in his home. Roxie, a Rat Terrier, is so timid that when a sudden noise disturbs her, she’ll pee on the floor.

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: Widow’s Dogs, Drool Dog, Dexter Follow-up
programme.desc: A retriever mix, and wire hair fox terriers siblings, have turned into a combative pack. A Sharpei/Dobie mix drools excessively. Rottie mix Dexter travels to Los Angeles for a refresher course.

programme.title: Cheaters: Episode 9
programme.desc: Laura discovers why her boyfriend avoids questions concerning his whereabouts. Follow up with Quincy Lett.

programme.title: Cheaters: Episode 10
programme.desc: Danielle finds her boyfriend in a secret rendezvous between workouts. Follow up with Sandra and Felix Ruiz.

programme.title: Cheaters: Episode 11
programme.desc: Nancy Bryant discovers how her husband deceptively allocates his resources. Follow up with Frank Angelo.

programme.title: Cheaters: Episode 12
programme.desc: Rafael uncovers his wife's attraction to a captain in the police department. Follow up with Alicia Smith.

programme.title: Cheaters: Episode 13
programme.desc: Phillip discovers his wife getting more than emotional support from a co-worker. Follow up with Vianey Ariaza.

programme.title: Cheaters: Episode 14
programme.desc: Caesar finds out his girlfriend is shopping around for a new man with more money. Follow up with Rob English.

programme.title: Cheaters: Episode 15
programme.desc: Greg Stephens discovers that his wife has a secret nightlife. Follow up with Will Montgomery.

programme.title: Cheaters: Episode 16
programme.desc: Star Jacobi finds out why her boyfriend's priorities have changed. Follow up with Denise Pennington.

programme.title: Cheaters: Episode 17

programme.title: Iron Chef

programme.title: Iron Chef

programme.title: Forensic Files: Frozen Assets
programme.desc: In 2004, Mary Ann Clibbery was found brutally murdered at her Illinois business. Investigators had to determine if this was a robbery gone wrong or a calculated murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: House Hunting
programme.desc: In 2006, Texas real estate agent Sarah Anne Walker was found brutally murdered in a model home. Weeks later, a witness came forward who may have seen the killer. Police used forensic hypnosis to help him recall every detail of the man's appearance.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shoot to Thrill
programme.desc: In 2003, St. Cloud teenager Jason MacLennan returned home after a night out with friends and discovered his father's body lying in a pool of blood.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Political Thriller
programme.desc: In 2006, Nevada politician Kathy Augustine died mysteriously during a re-election campaign. The medical examiner could neither isolate the cause of death, nor explain the tiny puncture wounds discovered during the autopsy.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Cross
programme.desc: In 1996, Virginia Beach police arrive at the Makdessi apartment to find the bloodied bodies of Elise Makdessi and Navy sailor Quincy Brown. But was Brown Elise's lover or her assailant?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dancing with the Devil
programme.desc: In 1999, Patrick McRae was found dead in his Des Moines home and the crime scene was awash with blood. Analysis showed it had come from two people, one of whom was female.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Last Dance
programme.desc: In 2000, the body of exotic dancer Rachel Siani was found beneath a New Jersey bridge. Investigators wondered if she had committed suicide. They discovered that Rachel offered to assist a drunk customer named John "Jack" Denofa to his motel room.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Constructive Criticism
programme.desc: In 2000, construction manager Darrell North was found dead in his work trailer in Ft. Worth, Texas. When investigators arrived, they found that he had been stabbed 46 times, indicating a personal relationship between the victim and the attacker.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Home Evasion
programme.desc: In 2000, Judy Southern arrived home from work and was shot by a gunman waiting within. Her husband arrived shortly afterwards, called emergency services and drove her to the hospital.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Window Watcher
programme.desc: In 1986, Gary Dale Larson was stabbed to death in his Edmond, Oklahoma home. The killer then sexually assaulted Larson's girlfriend, Janet Haynes.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Buried Secrets
programme.desc: Forensic scientists find clues written in blood as they investigate the deaths of three women killed by the men who once loved them.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Blood
programme.desc: The forces of nature can reduce a body to bones in a matter of weeks. Using a unique combination of art and science, forensic anthropologists give victims a face long after they have been forgotten.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Proof Of Innocence
programme.desc: DNA analysis overturns the convictions of three men who have spent years behind bars, paying for crimes they did not commit.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Drawing Conclusions
programme.desc: A teenager is abducted on a shopping trip. Two hikers disappear from the Appalachian Trail.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stranger Than Fiction
programme.desc: A millionaire is found dead, murdered for a stash of buried silver. A young woman dates violent men, only to be killed by her best friend.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Drive Thru Murder
programme.desc: Missy Berry is found dead in an idling car at a deserted intersection. A surprise twist in the investigation leads him into uncharted territory.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Into Thin Air
programme.desc: 24yr old Lorraine Laribo is dropped off at a bar by her sister's boyfriend. It's the last time anyone would ever see her alive again. Kenda must use his interrogation skills to find her killer.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Master Key
programme.desc: When a pregnant mother and her two young sons are brutally slain, pressure mounts for the CSPD to catch the cold-blooded monster who did it.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Nine-Year-Old Hostage
programme.desc: A hostage situation puts Sgt. Joe Kenda and his team to the test, as they try to save a family without getting shot themselves.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Human Animal
programme.desc: The naked body of a vibrant young mother is found frozen solid in a deserted cemetery. Kenda reopens the investigation and recognizes the sinister hallmark of a serial killer.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Blood On the Tracks
programme.desc: When an unsuspecting train conductor discovers a decapitated body on a lonely stretch of track, Lt. Joe Kenda must unravel the mystery of his death.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Beginning of the End, Apollo Gets Complicated & The End of Apollo
programme.desc: The Beginning of the End - After the first Moon landing the Apollo science program was about to start in earnest but people were losing interest. Apollo Gets Complicated - New technology is added that extends the reach of the Apollo program.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Gemini, Venus Express, EMU & Deep Space Communication
programme.desc: Project Gemini Commences - Did Gemini give the US a lead in the space race? Venus Express - The last days of ESA's Venus probe. EMU - NASA's Extravehicular Mobility Unit. Deep Space Communications - ESA's worldwide network of giant dishes.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Flight Status
programme.desc: The next 12 months will see an intense rise in flight tests, demonstration launches and high priority flights. Some are on time others are not. We check the flight status of some of this new hardware and these new capabilities.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Juno, Cassini and Beyond
programme.desc: The Amazing Cassini spacecraft and its sibling lander, Huygens, have now concluded their scientific studies, bringing back years of data. Now, Juno piercing the cloak of Jupiter and her distant relative New Horizons at the edge of the solar system.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Living Planet
programme.desc: We have been observing Earth for 40 years now, in the last 20 we have focus with intensity on the planet with new technologies and capabilities, we have accumulated a mass of data that is now revealing a complex and ever changing living planet.

programme.title: The Apollo Experience: Apollo 17: Part 2
programme.desc: In this episode, hear first hand testimonials and dialogue from the incredible men who walked on the moon. Incredible footage and photos give a unique and beautiful experience of their data collection process and journey home.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Beyond Earth Orbit, IXV Vehicles & Galileo Satellites Lost and Found
programme.desc: Beyond Earth Orbit - The Apollo program takes bold new steps. IXV Re-entry Vehicle - Europe is working to perfect a re-entry vehicle. Galileo Satellites Lost and Found - Navigation satellites go into incorrect orbit.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Living with Space
programme.desc: Astronauts and Cosmonauts train and study for years to work and live aboard the International Space Station. With this wealth of experience and insight behind them what do they think when they return to Earth?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Cosmic Collisions
programme.desc: Space is vast, yet it is full of collisions. Gas and dust electrostatically flock together, and gravity takes over coalescing grains into rocks. Those rocks become boulders, then asteroids colliding again and again, striking planets and each other.

programme.title: iCarly: En megafed idé

programme.title: iCarly: Hr. Næsten Perfekt
programme.desc: Carly er lun på Jake, som går på skolen. Han er supercool og ser godt ud. Carly er vild med Jake, så hun inviterer ham til at spille guitar og synge i hendes nye webshow. Hun finder desværre ud af, at Jake er en forfærdelig sanger.

programme.title: iCarly: Kampagne-konkurrencen
programme.desc: Carly og Sam konkurrerer mod Freddie og Spencer om hvem, der kan få flest børn til at se iCarly webcast. Men det stikker helt af, da alle deres planer går grueligt galt.

programme.title: iCarly: En anmelders gunst
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie vil gerne have deres webshow anmeldt af 'Nevelocity', et superpopulært websted, der anmeldelser hjemmesider og webcasts. Da Carly skal møde Nevel finder hun ud af, at han er en irriterende dreng, der gerne vil på date med hende.

programme.title: iCarly: Ude godt, men Spencer er bedst
programme.desc: Carly og Spencers bedstefar kommer på uanmeldt besøg. Han er meget bekymret for, om Spencer er for uansvarlig og skør til at være Carlys værge. Det er op til Carly og hendes venner at overbevise hendes bedstefar om, at Spencer er en ansvarlig værge.

programme.title: iCarly: Rekordforsøget
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie prøver at slå verdensrekorden i den længste, sammenhængende webcast. For at slå rekorden skal iCarly være på i mere end 24 timer i træk.

programme.title: iCarly: En date med Freddie
programme.desc: En iCarly-fan, Valerie, inviterer Freddie på en date. Daten går så godt, at Freddie begynder at filme Valeries eget webshow. Men Freddie føler sig splittet, da Valeries webshow skaber problemer for iCarly-webshowet.

programme.title: iCarly: Kunstneriske kvaler
programme.desc: Carly inviterer Spencers kunsthelt, Harry Joyner, til at kigge på Spencers kunstværker. Da Harry kalder Spencers kunst for amatøragtigt, føler Spencer, at hans liv ikke længere giver mening.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Igen tager drengene med deres kamera ud til skønne mennesker, der er noget for andre. Og i den nordjyske by Hals, falder de over en mand, der har en skøn historie fra sin tid som spejder – en historie, der til stadighed får ham til at gøre gode gerninger.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Der går nærmest hjælpemiddelcentral i den i de videoer, der med i dag – to ældre mennesker med rollatorer og Pelle i en rullestol. Det er med andre ord scenarier med folk, der virkelig har brug for hjælp og dermed ekstra rørende, når folk springer til.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Bedst som René og Pelle troede, at det at hjælpe i ”Den Gode Gerning” udelukkende var for ældre mennesker, så kommer de unge på banen. Dagens videoer er fulde af dejlige unge mennesker, der springer til og på skønneste vis giver håb for ungdommen.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Udenom og sågar henover – sådan foregår det, når folk skal passere det løbehjul, som vi har lagt på gaden midt i Århus. Det skaber stor forargelse skaber vores første virale hit. Se også hvordan det går, når vi gentager eksperimentet i Odense.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Vi fortæller om, hvordan det er, når vi skal finde en kvinde på gaden, som vi kan gøre gravid. Det er en vild, sjov og skør opgave. Vi har også en medvirkende, der virkelig er presset over hendes opgave og så én, der ikke fatter, hvad der ramte ham.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Malmö

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Finland's South Coast

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Kiruna

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Bergen
programme.desc: Surrounded by some of the most beautiful landscapes in northern Europe, Bergen has become a centre for the finest seafood in northern Europe. Tareq heads into this winter wonderland to see the curious cuisine that has developed in western Norway.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: The Faroe Islands

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Central Jutland
programme.desc: Volcanoes and glaciers shaped this part of the country, leaving a giant fjord and pre-historic fossils in their wake. Farmers and food innovators work closely with nature to prepare food with the area’s plentiful herbs and award-winning seafood.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Åland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: iCarly: Vi sælger tech-foots!

programme.title: iCarly: TV reddet af iCarly

programme.title: Modern Marvels

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Built with the pioneering use of steel-wire support cables, the Brooklyn Bridge became an instant symbol of American pride; rare photographs and behind-the-scenes stories recall the politics, the struggles, and the tragedies that made it possible.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: More than 50 years after its construction, the Golden Gate remains one of the world's great engineering marvels. It took 25-million man-hours and 80,000 miles of cable to complete; the cost in human life proved even greater.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: A large factory-fishing boat hunts down, catches and processes 300 tons of Alaskan pollock each day in the Bering Sea; the crew reveals the inner workings of one of the most sophisticated and complex vessels afloat.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Preparing for War

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Hitler's Biggest Blunder
programme.desc: Hitler rules Europe triumphantly, hailed as a hero in Germany. Hitler invades the Soviet Union, promising swift victory over communism, but progress stalls. As Germany faces setbacks, Hitler retreats to his bunker in Poland, increasingly reliant on drugs.

programme.title: Turbomodul
programme.desc: Sidste og verdens bedste afsnit for denne gang. Tonni Bonde synes fx at du bør købe en slæde. Helt seriøst. Hvis nu doktoren og Rambo leger 'doktor', hvem passer så skuden? Fjeder har været et smut forbi en S/M-klub. Har han faktisk taget munden for fuld?

programme.title: Ditzel og jagten på julemanden
programme.desc: Det er første søndag i advent, og Ditzel er pissesur! Sidste år fik han nemlig alt for få julegaver, så i år vil han have fat i ham den røde prop, som står for uddelingen af alle gaverne.

programme.title: Ditzel og jagten på julemanden
programme.desc: Ditzel er rejst helt hen til det lokale indkøbscenter, for der plejer Julemanden jo altid at hænge ud med en masse unger på skødet. Det er et oplagt sted at starte!

programme.title: Ditzel og jagten på julemanden
programme.desc: Ingen held i indkøbscenteret, men nu har Ditzel totalt regnet den ud! For han er faldet over beviser på, at Julemanden skulle bo på et sted kaldet Granland med masser af grønne grantræer.

programme.title: Ditzel og jagten på julemanden
programme.desc: Ditzel er desperat! Han har brugt tre dage i sin søgen efter Julemanden, men uden held. Og desperate situationer kræver jo som bekendt desperate handlinger, så derfor rejser Ditzel simpelthen tilbage i tiden til 1800-tallet.

programme.title: Ditzel og jagten på julemanden
programme.desc: Det er 25. december, og julen er overstået - men det ved Ditzel ikke, og stor er glæden da også, da han støder ind i selveste nissen Pyrus fra den der julekalender med 3D-brillerne!

programme.title: Jacob Ditzel vs. Puberteten
programme.desc: Jacob er sengeliggende. Det går dog hurtigt op for Lars, at det måske ikke står heeelt så slemt til, som Jacob selv mener. Men, Lars ved godt at puberteten er en besværlig tid, så han forbarmer sig over Jacob og tilbyder ham sin assistance.

programme.title: Jacob Ditzel vs. Puberteten
programme.desc: For at få afdækket en smule af pubertetens mysterie, og måske ændret ved Jacobs vrangforestillinger deraf, er de taget et smut forbi en ekspert på området.

programme.title: Jacob Ditzel vs. Puberteten
programme.desc: Jacob er blevet kropsbevidst. Selvom han i forvejen er en ‘hunk', er der et par skridt endnu, før han når ‘stunner’, og dét har han tænkt sig at gøre noget ved. Derfor er han taget i fitnesscenter for at få styr på sin bod’.

programme.title: Jacob Ditzel vs. Puberteten
programme.desc: Det er endelig lykkes Lars at overbevise Jacob om, at selvom puberteten er skrøbelig og forvirrende størrelse, er alt ved den også helt og aldeles normalt. Ja, også at onanere. Sidstnævnte viser sig at det er en sand pandoras æske.

programme.title: Jacob Ditzel vs. Puberteten
programme.desc: Jacob er ved at forberede sig til klassefesten. Jacob og Lars er ikke helt enige i, hvordan man gebærder sig overfor det modsatte køn. Derfor tager de ud til en, der underviser i takt og tone.

programme.title: Jacob Ditzel vs. Puberteten
programme.desc: Lars har fået ondt af Jacob. Han husker selv hvor svært den slags med tøser kunne være, og kan være. Derfor har Lars (måske mod betaling) fået fat i en “tøs”, der trods den ret voldsomme aldersforskel, er interesseret i en date med Jacob.

programme.title: Jacob Ditzels konfirmation
programme.desc: Jacob har nået konfirmationsalderen, men han er dog ikke videre begejstret over konfirmationsforberedelserne og den svage præst. Og biblen? Bare topnoller fiktion fra øverste hylde.

programme.title: Jacob Ditzels konfirmation
programme.desc: Jacob er blevet Kristian ad helvedes til, for jo mere man tror på Jesus, jo flere gaver får man til sin kongdiamation! Jacob er derfor taget til epicentret af al skam, lyst og synd - Bycentret - hvor han prøver at frelse alle de rådne sjæle.

programme.title: Jacob Ditzels konfirmation
programme.desc: Jacob skal selvfølgelig have nyt tøj prøver samtidigt at holde hjulene i samfundet kørende ved at bruge rigtig maaaange pang'. Kviklån? Ja tak. Let's go shopping!

programme.title: Jacob Ditzels konfirmation
programme.desc: Dagen er kommet, hvor Jacob Ditzel skal kongdiameres - hvis altså verdens ringeste præst har tænkt sig at give ham lov.

programme.title: Jacob Ditzels konfirmation
programme.desc: Ingen konfirmation uden fest for fulde sejl!

programme.title: Jacob Ditzels konfirmation
programme.desc: Det er Blå Mandag, og ALT går fuldstændig bananas! Dagen bliver præget af en Jacob, der tydelig har fået alt for meget sukker, frozen nips og selvbruner i hele skærmen.

programme.title: Ditzel All Inklusiv
programme.desc: Jacob Ditzel er blevet så berømt, at ham og Lars er blevet hyret til at lave en reportageserie fra Mallorca.

programme.title: Ditzel All Inklusiv
programme.desc: Lars er træt af, at Jacob kun er rejst med for at fede den ved poolen. Han er også bekymret for, om de overhovedet får nogle brugbare optagelser i kassen.

programme.title: Ditzel All Inklusiv

programme.title: Ditzel All Inklusiv

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Are You The One?

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 805
programme.desc: Lige uden for Halden ligger et sted kaldet Aremark, og her giver et ungt par Halvor frie tøjler til at renovere deres skovhytte. Torkel fælder et træ, som bliver lavet om til både bænk, bord og kunst.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 806
programme.desc: Dette års vinterhytte har udsigt over Vågå og er en typisk 80'er fyrretræshytte. Hytten er klar til at blive renoveret, og Halvor viser, hvordan man kan genbruge gamle vinduer og give møbler nyt liv.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 901
programme.desc: Sæsonens første afsnit tager os med til smukke Rott i Tananger. Her er et gammelt "jærhus" ved at blive renoveret. Der bliver bl.a. ændret i grundplanen, og Ole bygger et hyggeligt udhus.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 902
programme.desc: I dette afsnit går turen til det populære sommerhusområde Hvaler, hvor holdet skal forvandle et sjælløst sommerhus til et maritimt paradis.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 903
programme.desc: For enden af et fjeld ved Tjomsland i Larvik kommune ligger et sommerhus, som man næsten ikke kan se. Holdet genbruger mere end normalt, men hytten er stadig helt uigenkendelig, når ugen er omme.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter: Episode 907
programme.desc: I dag bliver deltagerne testet i det berygtede søde køkken, hvor udfordringerne er mange. Det er nemlig ikke længere nok at aflevere en velsmagende is, hvis du ikke kan servere den som en smuk quenelle.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter: Episode 908
programme.desc: Årets bootcamps sluttes af med en klassisker i MasterChef-køkkenet: stegning af kød og fisk. Dommerne forlanger en perfekt stegt bøf og et sprødt skind på toppen af fisken.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter: Episode 909
programme.desc: Hold på hat og (nitro-)briller! For de indledende uger starter med en hæsblæsende dag – der er nemlig teknik på programmet. Deltagerne udfordres, for der skal både dampes samt bruges nitrogen og sifon.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter: Episode 910
programme.desc: Ingen bøf uden bearnaise. I dag er der nemlig dømt masser af hygge i MasterChef-køkkenet, når deltagerne kastes ud i en omgang bøf bearnaise efterfulgt af en skøn fransk dessert.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter: Episode 911
programme.desc: Alle verdenshjørner bliver besøgt, når deltagerne laver mad, de har en helt særlig tilknytning til. De tilbageværende madtalenter tager nemlig dommerne med på en tur til deres bedste ferieminde.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1311
programme.desc: Det går sjældent kedeligt for sig i selskab med realitystjerne, model og influencer Sinan Türkmen, og det gør det heller ikke, når han inviterer til middag i sit hjem på Østerbro i København.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1312
programme.desc: Selvom man bor småt, kan man godt invitere til middagsselskab. Det beviser radio- og tv-vært Helin Erdem, når hun inviterer sine gæster med til sit elskede Albertslund.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1313
programme.desc: Pizzakokken Gorm Wisweh inviterer til middag i sommerhuset ved Jægerspris. Men hvis gæsterne vil have noget at spise, må de selv hjælpe til. Tilgengæld lukker Gorm op for personlige historier.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1315
programme.desc: TV-kendissen Linse Kessler byder på middag på sin elskede Bryggen, Islands Brygge i København. Her er plads til latter og sang, men med Linses nuværende økonomi er der ikke plads til meget mere.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1316
programme.desc: Politikeren Sikandar Siddique byder sine gæster indenfor til en oplevelse, der giver gæsterne et indblik i sin baggrund, og vi er med når Sikandar åbner op om en yderst svær periode i sit liv.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1301
programme.desc: Realitystjernen Gustav Salinas byder indenfor i sin eksklusive lejlighed. Værten byder på mad fra varme lande, og lukker sine farvestrålende gæster indenfor i sit svære kærlighedsliv.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 103
programme.desc: Vi besøger Sabine og Jakob i deres lejelejlighed i Valby. Datteren Solveig har værelse i et pulterrum på 4 m2, så familien har desperat brug for at flytte i noget større.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 104
programme.desc: Sonja og Emil bor de sammen med sønnen Vilmer på 1 år. De har selv totalistandsat lejligheden og det var så hårdt, at de ikke kan overskue endnu en istandsættelse.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 105
programme.desc: Charlotte og Martin får besøg af vært Lisbeth Østergaard og de to eksperter i deres lejlighed. Charlotte er flyttet ind i Martins lejlighed, men drømmer om at starte på en frisk og flytte ind i et hus, hvor de kan starte familie.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 201
programme.desc: Vært Camilla Ottesen, ejendomsmægler Tobias Edlev Nielsen og arkitekt Mads Kappel Mikkelsen besøger Ida og Aske på Østerbro, som har ledt efter bolig i et år, men stadig ikke har fundet drømmehuset.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 705
programme.desc: I de smukkeste omgivelser i Korsør lystskov ligger restaurant Sommerlyst. Stedet er drevet af Jesper og Yvonne, der 4 måneder inde i deres forpagtning, allerede er ved at kaste håndklædet i ringen.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 706
programme.desc: Restaurant Limone drives af ægteparret Johnny og Helle. Restauranten, der ligger inde i en biograf, kæmper med at få gæster til at komme og spise - og ikke bare gå i biografen.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 501
programme.desc: På Gesten Kro er forpagteren Tim på 34 år magtesløs. Aften efter aften står restauranten tom, og når der endelig kommer gæster, bliver de ikke længere end højest nødvendigt.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 502
programme.desc: På Orø Kro har de et blakket ry. De lokale holder sig væk, og en madanmelder har for nylig givet restauranten to stjerner i en landsdækkende avis.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 503
programme.desc: På restaurant Chopstix taber den 27årige ejer Mark hver måned 30.000 kr. Trods central placering i hjertet af København har restauranten ingen kunder.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Toxic Shots Syndrome
programme.desc: Snooki flytter ud af huset og Deena har det svært uden sin kødbolle. Mike må døjes med følgerne af sin bedring efter et lægebesøg.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Blues, Balls, & Brawls
programme.desc: Jenni fødselsdagsfest for Roger går helt galt. Deena prøver Danny af som kødbolle. Og bofællerne havner midt i et stort skænderi.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Merp Walk
programme.desc: Jenni finder ud af, hvor skadet hun er. Da Deena holder kødbolleprøver, ender hun med at falde ud af stegepanden og ind i ilden.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Let's Make it Official
programme.desc: Jenni indser, at hun og Roger måske har større problemer end hun troede. Og Mike beslutter, at det er tid til at bringe forholdet til Paula op på næste niveau.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Great Meatballs of Fire
programme.desc: Mike skal vænne sig til at være i et forhold og bliver forvirret af reglerne. Deena opfører sig som en kødbolle igen og må kæmpe for sin ret til at feste.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Control the Crazy
programme.desc: Sammi konfronterer Deena og de kommer op at toppes. Mike og bofællerne ser Paulas 'vilde' side og Mike er ikke sikker på, det er hans stil.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Fight Night!
programme.desc: Nathan holder en surprisefest for Tahlia, hans bedste singleven. Aaron beder huset om at støtte ham til sin første MMA-fight i Newcastle. Alle bakker op om Aaron.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Meet The Newbies
programme.desc: Den nye sæson af Geordie Shore starter snart, men før den gør det har Scotty samlet de fleste af de medvirkende til en snak om serien, og til et møde med de fire nye deltagere, som han selv har valgt.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Shake Ups & Break Ups!
programme.desc: Alt er ikke godt! Chloe og Sam har slået op og slænget er bekymrede for, hvordan det vil påvirke familien. James og Abbie vender tilbage til huset, men den første aften ender katastrofalt da Beau fortæller Bethan at det er slut!

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Give It Another Go!
programme.desc: Sam indser, at han må tale om tingene med Chloe, så de forlader huset for at tale ud. De beslutter sig for at prøve igen, men det bliver resten af huset ikke glade for at høre.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Tensions Keep Rising!
programme.desc: Chloe konfronterer pigerne om ikke at støtte hendes beslutning om at finde sammen med Sam igen. Sam overrasker Chloe, mens hans opførsel på en bytur truer med at ødelægge deres forhold igen. Abbie fortæller James at hun så Chloe med en fyr.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Party in Portugal!
programme.desc: Sam træffer en stor beslutning, da slænget får at vide, at de skal til Portugal. På trods af det, fester familien løs i Algarve. Men spændingerne mellem Bethan, Beau og Abbie truer med at koge over og ødelægge ferien.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Den berømte uniform
programme.desc: Der er gået to uger af træningslejren, og Kelli og Judy begynder at vælge de første fra. Ugens øvetimer er vigtige for alle pigerne, da de forventes at mestre den verdensberømte DCC-kickline og at gå i spagat.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Makeovers
programme.desc: Det er træningslejrens tredje uge, og de nye hentes ind til deres DCC-makeovers. De får et nyt look med frisure og makeup og forvandles i DCC-støbeformen.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: PR-fotos
programme.desc: Aftenens prøver starter med et brag, da DCC's Technical Director Kitty Carter aflægger et uventet besøg på Valley Ranch.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: På banen
programme.desc: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders er to uger fra den første kamp og DCC's leder Kelli McGonagill Finglass og DCC-koreografen Judy Trammel har travlt med at udskille de sidste og sætte holdet.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Finalen
programme.desc: Alt afhænger af træningslejrens sidste aften. I aften opfyldes eller knuses drømme. Kelli udfordrer pigerne ved at tage dem med på Cowboys' træningsbane for at se dem optræde.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 1
programme.desc: It’s Monday at Barnsley Casualty, traditionally the busiest day of the week and they’re expecting to treat 277 patients. But it soon becomes clear that this shift could break the hospital record of 349 patients, a number that no-one wants to beat.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 2
programme.desc: Freezing fog has descended across the whole of South Yorkshire so Barnsley Casualty is inundated with weather-related accidents and emergencies.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 3
programme.desc: After eight weeks off with a fractured hip, Consultant Dr Julian Humphrey returns to work at Barnsley Casualty. A keen cyclist, he came off his bike in Sheffield and by his own admission is ‘a bit accident prone – I’m the NHS secret shopper.’

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 4
programme.desc: It’s a busy day in Barnsley Hospital’s casualty department and one that holds a special significance for Nurse Jade Melia - it’s her last shift.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Episode 5
programme.desc: Sister Jane Hawksworth is managing the ambulance arrivals, ‘It’s so unpredictable and you can have the worst day ever and think nothing can compare to it and then come back and have another worst day ever. And then gradually the days will get better.’

programme.title: Forensic Files: DNA Dragnet
programme.desc: Digital enhancement of security camera footage shows that what appears to be a casual encounter is actually a forced abduction. When investigators suspect the crimes are not random, they fear a serial killer may be on the loose.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smiley Face
programme.desc: The woman had been sexually assaulted, stabbed repeatedly and left for dead. When a perfect suspect practically turned himself in, police were sure they had their man until DNA evidence proved them wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dirty Laundry
programme.desc: The victim was a self-made man who never minced words. Perhaps he was murdered by a disgruntled client or employee. Perhaps the racy photos in his safe held the clue to solving the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Drowning Sorrows
programme.desc: A family vacation turns into a nightmare when a woman is found face-down in a lake.

programme.title: Forensic Files: As Fault
programme.desc: Witnesses saw a woman in the back of a truck, flailing her arms and screaming. When they found a jacket near a pool of blood, they knew what they had seen wasn't a joy ride.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Family Ties
programme.desc: When court clerk Peter Porco doesn't report to work in November 2004, a courts officer is ordered to the Porcos' family home in Bethlehem, NY.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Trouble Brewing
programme.desc: Two suspects are linked to a murder by bloodstained boots and a gun, but the owner of the items says he has never met the victim. Investigators hope manufacturing codes from beer bottles will determine who is telling the truth.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Holy Terror
programme.desc: This episode documents a deadly bombing at a church in Oakwood, Illinois, in December 1997.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Needle in a Haystack
programme.desc: There was no clear reason for a young, healthy college student to be dead. But when the coroner discovered a tiny clue during the autopsy, investigators were able to uncover a mystery filled with betrayal and revenge.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Room with a View
programme.desc: A young woman is stabbed more than 100 times. The killer leaves DNA behind, but investigators must play a cat-and-mouse game to obtain a suspect's DNA to match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Model Killer
programme.desc: It's a model's job to rivet the public's attention. But in 1984, some aspiring models began attracting publicity in a terrible new way.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hired Gun
programme.desc: When three people were found murdered in their home, it appeared like a burglary gone awry. But a crime this horrific deserved a closer look.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Collective Justice
programme.desc: Philadelphia's Vidocq Society, named after an 18th Century French detective, is one of the world's most unusual crime-solving organizations.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder For Hire
programme.desc: For some killers, murder can be a profitable business. And the scene of the crime can be both a source for clues, and puzzling questions. When a victim has been targeted for death, investigators must look beyond the obvious to uncover a murder for hire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Toxic Death
programme.desc: Sometimes, the cause of death does not match the scene of the crime. When an untraceable poison is used to commit murder, homicide detectives turn to forensic toxicologists to follow a killer's tracks and expose a toxic death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Material Witness
programme.desc: Lies and deceit can often throw investigators off the trail of justice. But when hard evidence contradicts a killer's story, police must use the clues to piece together the truth.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Betrayed
programme.desc: Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental or the result of a tragic accident, it is up to forensic scientists to reveal the deception lying just below the surface.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Sing Sing, Little Bird
programme.desc: A romantic rendezvous is cut short by a violent home invasion, leaving young business owner Kelly Knudson bleeding to death on the floor and Lt Joe Kenda is short on leads.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Night Terrors
programme.desc: When Cheryl Brantner’s children find her dead in her bathtub, Lt. Joe Kenda must decide if this was a soapy accident or something worse.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: 12 Years a Fugitive
programme.desc: When a beloved grandmother is found stabbed to death in her own home, Kenda must turn to a tight-knit community still grieving from the tragic loss.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Weapon of Choice
programme.desc: When mother of two Shaundra Murr is run over in front of her house, officers initially suspect a hit and run. Until Lt. Joe Kenda uncovers evidence proving Shaundra’s murder was a crime of passion.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Standoff
programme.desc: A disabled man is killed on the job, but Kenda’s case hits a roadblock when forensic evidence is scrubbed from the scene.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Shooting Gallery: Asteroids and Comets / Galactic Visions: Alien Worlds
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: To The Moon, SpaceX's Dragon and Falcon & GAIA
programme.desc: To the Moon - The Apollo program achieves its major objective. Dragon, Falcon and Spacex - New directions in re-usable spacecraft. Gaia- Mapping our galaxy in unprecedented detail.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Mercury Advancement, Camera Tracking & The International Space Station
programme.desc: Project Mercury Advances - America's first manned space program finally puts a man in orbit. Camera Tracking - The array of special cameras that follow a spacecraft at launch. The International Space Station - The building and operation.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Dark Side
programme.desc: In terms of the Universe, we know we don't know much, especially when it comes to dark matter and dark energy. Scientists are devoting so much of their time to discovering as much as the possibly can about this mysterious matter.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Gas Giants
programme.desc: In the cold, dark expanse of our solar system, beyond the asteroid belt, lie the giant planets. Some can be seen with the naked eye, others have been visited by our camera. What secrets do they hold?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Atmosphere
programme.desc: Our atmosphere is an unbelievably complex machine that protects us from the vacuum of space, shelters us from harmful radiation and allows us and the biosphere to breath; we need to learn much more about it so we can better it.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Superscopes
programme.desc: The human eye can only see visible light, a small spectrum of electromagnetic waves. Today, we have instruments that let us perceive all wavelengths.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Night Fire
programme.desc: The Northern Lights are more than just beautiful; they tell us about the make up of our planet, our sun, and may even be a signpost for the possibility of life on other planets.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Race, The Hubble, Chasing Comets & Space Debris
programme.desc: Cold War & The Start of the Space Race - Cold War rivalry and the acceleration of space exploration. Servicing Hubble - Preparations for Hubble's final servicing mission. Chasing a Comet - Launch and the difficult path to rendezvous.

programme.desc: Doctors don't know why a young scientist has fallen gravely ill. When tests finally reveal the cause, it's too late to save him.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All that Glitters is Gold
programme.desc: Police discover a bullet-riddled car, a missing driver and no witnesses. Had the victim been abducted or was she dead? The answers are found in a unique clue, so tiny it was measured in millionths of a meter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Rebellion
programme.desc: Even though their daughter had run away before, she had always come back. Her parents were sure this time would be no different, but they were wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign of the Crime
programme.desc: In little more than a month, two women who lived in the same apartment complex were brutally murdered. The similarities of the crime scenes led police to conclude they were dealing with a serial killer who harbored an intense hatred of women.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Covet Thy Neighbour
programme.desc: When a college student vanished without a trace, her fellow students were concerned about her safety and their own.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Writing on the Wall
programme.desc: The victim was well-liked and successful, which made the brutality of the crime even harder to understand.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hundreds of Reasons
programme.desc: An assistant manager of a Florida steakhouse is stabbed to death. It appears to be a robbery gone wrong, but a bloody fingerprint reveals that he knew his killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cold Feet
programme.desc: In 1985, Julie Estes was kidnapped from the Southside convenience store where she worked. Her body was found the next day, but the killing went unsolved until 2003.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hired Gun
programme.desc: When three people were found murdered in their home, it appeared like a burglary gone awry. But a crime this horrific deserved a closer look.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Betrayed
programme.desc: Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental or the result of a tragic accident, it is up to forensic scientists to reveal the deception lying just below the surface.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Elements Of Murder
programme.desc: There are several things that can suggest murder; jealousy, anger, poison. When everyday substances reveal hidden clues that break a homicide case, those substances become the elements of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Random Targets
programme.desc: Most victims of multiple murderers are meticulously chosen because of a mutual connection with the killer or because they match an intricate set of criteria that fits the killer's MO.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Grave Secrets
programme.desc: Killers often attempt to deflect attention away from their crimes by hiding the remains of their victims. Bodies may lay hidden for years before they are discovered.

programme.title: The New Detectives: At Close Range
programme.desc: When a victim is gunned down at point-blank range, police often assume that a friend or acquaintance is to blame.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Encounter
programme.desc: In most homicides, police rely on motive to pursue a murderer. But when the killer is a stranger the crime may go unsolved for years. It takes a full arsenal of forensic techniques to trace a lethal encounter.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Standoff
programme.desc: A disabled man is killed on the job, but Kenda’s case hits a roadblock when forensic evidence is scrubbed from the scene.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Jekyll & Hyde
programme.desc: Lt. Joe Kenda looks for answers in the death of Calvin Blair, a young man stabbed and left for dead on the roadside.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Slaughterhouse Six
programme.desc: Solider and young father Layne Schmidtke is brutally beaten to death by a mob of teenagers. Kenda must reconstruct the chaotic scene through forensic evidence and witness testimonies.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bad Moon Rising
programme.desc: The night before Halloween, a real-life nightmare unfolds when a young man is found clinging to life. The case takes a dark turn when Lt. Joe Kenda learns there is a second victim somewhere in the woods.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Hail of Bullets
programme.desc: The murder of a young father stuns his close-knit community, but the investigation reveals a neighborly dispute turned deadly.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Mr. LA
programme.desc: A young man tries to flee a violent scene, but is shot dead behind the wheel of his car. A peculiar clue puts Kenda hot on the heels of a self-styled gangster with revenge on his mind.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Race, The Hubble, Chasing Comets & Space Debris
programme.desc: Cold War & The Start of the Space Race - Cold War rivalry and the acceleration of space exploration. Servicing Hubble - Preparations for Hubble's final servicing mission. Chasing a Comet - Launch and the difficult path to rendezvous.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Stars Above
programme.desc: The life cycle of stars reveal to us the past and the future of Earth and ourselves.

programme.title: The Apollo Experience: Apollo 17: Part 1
programme.desc: Between 1960 and 1972, mankind boldly went where no human had been before. Across 11 manned missions, 24 men flew to the moon and 12 walked upon its surface. This film documents Apollo 17 through the eyes of the astronauts who flew.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rays
programme.desc: Cosmic rays can tell us much about the universe. They are not simply another form of light, but carriers of information about powerful and unseen processes at work thousands or even millions of light years away.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Exo Planets
programme.desc: As scientists and astronomers peer more closely and with evermore fidelity at nearby stars, they are discovering countless exo planets. How many Earth-like planets are out there? Could one of them hold life not so different from our own?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: First Light
programme.desc: The Hubble Telescope is nearing its end, the replacements are ready to go, ready to peer further back in time and space than can be imagined.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Invasion Mars
programme.desc: For over 50 years we have bombarded Mars with our probes and landers. Spying from orbit to map terrain, finding her strengths and weaknesses. The time nearing for the full scale invasion of the planet, when humans walk on Mars and claim it for their own.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity has long been a force that has intrigued scientists. Now, for the first time scientists are probing to detect gravity waves in space as well as mapping the gravity patterns of the moon.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Giant Planets: Lords of Gravity / Outer Limits: Edge of the Solar System
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: iCarly: Lewberts uheldige dag
programme.desc: En 'Dril Lewbert'-sketch går helt skævt og skader Carlys irriterende dørmand. Slænget plejer ham, indtil Freddies mor tager over. Men da kærligheden begynder at blomstre, må de sætte en stopper for det.

programme.title: iCarly: Tærtemysteriet
programme.desc: Da Carly, Sam og Spencer tager Freddie med til deres yndlingskonditori, finder de ud af, at forpagteren er død. Men endnu værre er, hans opskrifter er måske gået tabt for evigt.

programme.title: iCarly: En anderledes jul
programme.desc: I et forsøg på at pifte julen op med et utraditionelt træ, kommer Spencer til at sætte ild til alle Carlys gaver. Fortvivlet ønsker hun, at hun havde en normal bror.

programme.title: iCarly: Det første kys
programme.desc: Sam overhører Freddie fortælle Carly, at han aldrig har kysset en pige, og afslører hans hemmelighed på netshowet. Gibby og Carly træner Spencer til udtagelser for det lokale professionelle fodboldhold.

programme.title: iCarly: Hvem vil have en bil?
programme.desc: Slænget kører en konkurrence på iCarly, og præmien er en ny til fra en lokal forhandler. Da Nevel vinder, opdager børnene, at forhandleren ikke kendte noget til konkurrencen eller bilen, de skulle give væk.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg møder Fred
programme.desc: Freddie siger offentligt, at han ikke er en fan af internetsensationen Fred, og får Fred til at meddele, at han holder op med at lave sine videoer. Hans fans bliver rasende over, at Freddie fik stoppet de populære videoer.

programme.title: iCarly: Et perfekt match
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Freddie sniger sig ud for at tage til en MMA-kamp, får de deres dobbeltgængere til at snøre Spencer til at tro, at de stadig er hjemme. Imens bygger Spencer en kæmpe version af Newton Balls.

programme.title: iCarly: Vi valgte vinderen
programme.desc: Da Carly, Sam og Freddie opfordrer iCarly-fans til at stemme på David Archuleta i Amerika Synger, får de ondt af nummer to og hjælper ham med at lave en musikvideo.

programme.title: iCarly: En sødere Sam
programme.desc: Da Sam indrømmer, at hun kan lide en dreng i skolen, lærer Carly hende, hvordan hun besnærer ham ved at opføre sig mere piget. Spencer er overbevist om, at en pige kan lide ham pga. hans smoking, så han går med den hele tiden.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg dater en forbryder Del 1
programme.desc: Da Carly dater er en hård negl, prøver hun at holde forholdet skjult for Spencer. Og Sam betaler Freddie for at bygge en hjemmeside med alle hendes klamme video-favoritter.

programme.title: iCarly: Gensyn med Missy
programme.desc: Da Carlys gamle veninde Missy flytter tilbage til Seattle, tror Sam, at Missy prøver at udskifte hende som Carlys bedste veninde.

programme.title: On the Case: A Window to Murder
programme.desc: A valiant teenager's dying act helps police solve the mystery behind her murder

programme.title: On the Case: A Mother's Nightmare
programme.desc: A young boy is murdered in his bed in the middle of the night. Police suspect the child's mother. Over the next 9 years there will be accusations, a confession and a conviction but will justice be served?

programme.title: On the Case: Murder by the Numbers?
programme.desc: A small town is outraged when its unofficial mayor is the victim of a vicious attack at work. The police investigation uncovers a number of possible suspects and a confusing trail of evidence but will it lead them to the person who committed the crime?

programme.title: On the Case: Vanished in the Night
programme.desc: When 20 year old Lynsie Ekelund suddenly goes missing in the dead of night, it leaves her mother scrambling for answers.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Thin Ice
programme.desc: C-46 and DC-4 crews race against the spring melt to fly mining equipment to an airstrip on a frozen lake. Jeremy tries to catch up to fellow rampies Audrey and Wilf.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ice Camp
programme.desc: Mikey trains for High Arctic survival with the Canadian Rangers. The Air Force invades Chuck's hangar. Joe faces tough competition at a California plane auction.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Gear Up, Gear Down
programme.desc: Frustrated with her lack of flying and stuck in a rut as a courier driver, Audrey decides her time at Buffalo is over.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: For Sale By Owner
programme.desc: When South Korean buyers come to Buffalo to look at a water bomber, the pressure is on mechanic Cory to get the plane ready. But a landing gear emergency puts him and chief pilot Justin in serious danger.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ski Plane
programme.desc: Young pilots AJ and Andrew get the chance of a lifetime to fly the magnificent DC-3 specially equipped with skis to land on frozen strips.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Dambusters
programme.desc: Buffalo gets into the stunt flying business when veteran pilot Arnie flies the DC-4 for the re- enactment scene of a famous WWII bombing raid.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Clown Did It
programme.desc: A report on the 1990 murder of Marlene Warren, and the decades long hunt for her killer: a clown bearing balloons, flowers and a gun.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Live to Tell: Trafficked
programme.desc: An examination of sex trafficking through the eyes of survivor Alyssa Beck and the vast array of people who tried to help her – from law enforcement and her family, to the legal system and child advocates.

programme.title: 48 Hours: What Happened in Apartment 4C?
programme.desc: A report on the 2016 disappearance and murder of Joey Comunale after a night of partying in New York City. While out clubbing, Comunale accepted an invitation to a party at a Sutton Place apartment with people he had just met.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Private Needham's War
programme.desc: A report on the case of Pvt. John Needham, a decorated soldier diagnosed with traumatic brain injury and PTSD, and investigators say beat his 19-year-old girlfriend Jacque Villagomez to death with his bare hands in September 2008.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Don't Scream
programme.desc: An investigation on Tiffany Mead of Davis County, Utah, a young mother who called 911 claiming she had sliced her own throat while her ex-husband and child watched.

programme.title: COPS: Settled with a Pipe
programme.desc: A man attacking a woman is tackled by an officer. A vehicle is pulled over for a drug deal in progress. A woman smashes a car window with a pipe in a fit of road rage.

programme.title: COPS: Dyed in the Wool
programme.desc: A suspect selling narcotics takes off on foot. A bank robber leaves his wallet in an abandoned money bag. Multiple domestic violence calls end in arrests.

programme.title: COPS: The House Always Wins
programme.desc: A suspect runs from an illegal gambling game claiming shots were fired. A man is caught trespassing on school grounds. A male driver wearing a halter top is pulled over for a minor traffic violation.

programme.title: COPS: Allergy Season
programme.desc: A drunk driver rams into a pursuing police car. A man on a bike flees an area known for drug activity on a bike. A sniffling man attempts to hide a baggie with narcotics under his shirt.

programme.title: COPS: Yard Work
programme.desc: Deputies respond to a call of a man shooting a gun in his front yard. Officers are called to a domestic dispute over an wrinkly infant's shirt. Four armed and suspicious men are spotted by deputies.

programme.title: COPS: Keep it Down!
programme.desc: An officer is forced to subdue a suspect with his baton. A man asks deputies to give him back his drugs before taking him to jail. A man causes a disturbance at an apartment complex.

programme.title: COPS: Hot Potato
programme.desc: A man tosses his stash after being pulled over. Officers question two men in a fight who live with the same woman. A man says his shorts are from a thrift store after drugs are found in them.

programme.title: COPS: Nerves of Noodles
programme.desc: A man tells deputies the pants he has on aren't his. Officers are called to the scene of men firing an ak-47. A nervous driver fesses up to the deputy who stopped him.

programme.title: COPS: What's Your Deductible?
programme.desc: Detectives chase a suspect who wrecks his car. Police are called when a man headbutts his neighbor. Officers tend to a woman punched in the face by her husband while on the bus.

programme.title: COPS: Wardrobe Malfunction
programme.desc: A suspect flees police in a truck over a misdemeanor traffic warrant. A man denies hitting his wife who has a bloody nose. A man denies ownership of his shorts when deputies find drugs in them.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Audrey Jouannet Case
programme.desc: September 16 2005. The lifeless body of Audrey Jouannet, 24, is found hidden under the bed in her small apartment in Soisy-sur-Seine. It soon becomes apparent that the young woman has been tortured at length before being strangled.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Sylvie Darcy Case
programme.desc: On February 26th 2012, in the Yevelines. Around 11PM policemen are called for an assault in a parking lot in the forest of Saint-Lambet-des-Bois.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Two Young Women Massacred: The Leconte Affair
programme.desc: On July 8, 2002, near Amiens, a farmer discovers the lifeless body of a young woman, Patricia Leclercq, on his field.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Jean-Jacques Le Page Case
programme.desc: On the morning of July 24th 2009, a fire erupts at house in Plougonvelin.

programme.title: UFO Hunters: UFO Surveillance
programme.desc: Ever since Roswell, observers have noted that UFOs allegedly appear in locations that are already full of secrets and mystery: namely, weapons labs. The question is, why?

programme.title: UFO Hunters: The Silencers

programme.title: UFO Hunters: Area 52
programme.desc: Area 51 is considered the ultimate top-secret facility, one that UFO investigators believe houses an extraterrestrial secret. But is there an even more secretive facility?

programme.title: UFO Hunters: First Response
programme.desc: For decades, it has been believed that the United States military has had unexplained encounters with the UFO phenomena.

programme.title: UFO Hunters: Dark Presence
programme.desc: There's a growing phenomenon of alleged UFO sightings known as Orbs. Witnesses who see the Orbs also report having dreams, premonitions, and a deep fear.

programme.title: Aliens Among Us: The Michael Wolf Theory

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Overlord
programme.desc: After a careful campaign of disinformation that throws the German defenders off-guard, the Western Allies finally land on Normandy.France is liberated.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Closing the Ring
programme.desc: The Western Allies secure supply routes that will allow them to enter Germany, and the Ardennes counter-offensive fails. The Red Army advances rapidly. The SS implements the Holocaust.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Final Solution
programme.desc: This is the story of how Hitler orchestrated the genocide of 6 million Jews. Hitler portrayed Jews as a societal threat, using Goebbels' propaganda. Deportations were masked as resettlements while Auschwitz-Birkenau became a death factory.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Nazis Outfought
programme.desc: By 1944, Hitler's image as a victorious leader is crumbling. He faces a bomb plot led by Stauffenberg and Tresckow, intending to kill him and overthrow the regime. Hitler survives the bombing, triggering a brutal reprisal against conspirators.

programme.title: Secret War: The French Triple Agent
programme.desc: Operation Cockade, led by MI6's double agent Henri Dericourt in 1943, aimed to deceive Germans with sabotage. Despite efforts, Germans withdrew divisions unconvinced. Dericourt faced a post-war treason trial and died in a mysterious 1962 plane crash.
